_doc: Round 5 paint-over for idle at 80 (r5_paint.py). Seeded from round 4's head layers (art/rosace/overrides/drive9/idle_80.json) moved by the head-skin offset R4u -> R5xu (0, -1), then re-authored for the round-4 critics' face and hair fixes. Layers with port: true are also painted on the twin build (R5u).

layers.name: face_base
layers.why: Face critic 2: clean face plane before the features (FC-P35), lit from the upper right.

layers.name: fringe
layers.why: Head and hair 4: the fringe in 4 tapered locks with dark gaps (5-7 at 144 is 3-4 at 80); the forehead shows between them.

layers.name: eye_near
layers.why: Face critic (round 4, face 2): 'an iris of deep indigo on top, desaturated blue in the middle and a 1 px pale lower catchlight; drop the pure cyan'. At 80 the eye keeps round 4's 3-4 row shape (a 2-row lash block would close it); the palette takes the 144 eye's ramp: D (was #86b8ee cyan) is now the pale desaturated #8ea6d2, B/C the muted blues.

layers.name: eye_far
layers.why: Face critic (round 4, face 2): 'an iris of deep indigo on top, desaturated blue in the middle and a 1 px pale lower catchlight; drop the pure cyan'. At 80 the eye keeps round 4's 3-4 row shape (a 2-row lash block would close it); the palette takes the 144 eye's ramp: D (was #86b8ee cyan) is now the pale desaturated #8ea6d2, B/C the muted blues.

layers.name: blush
layers.why: Face critic 2: the 2-tone blush, one px each tone at 80.

layers.name: mouth
layers.why: Attractiveness 3: an asymmetric closed smile, the far corner lifted.

layers.name: strands_out
layers.why: Head and hair 4: one loose strand breaks the outline at 80 (two at 144).

layers.name: tail_tips
layers.why: Body critic (round 4, arms and hands 6): 'the free hand is a detached blue claw at the hip'. It is the hair tail's azure tips fanning under the hip hand. Inside the hip box they take the hair's own violet ramp by value rank (the tips higher up keep the azure, DESIGN's identity).

layers.name: fist
layers.why: Body critic (round 4, arms and hands 6): 'show a 4-5 px fist high on the haft with a gold cuff so the grip reads at 144 and at 80'. At 80 a 4x4 fist under the disc at the render's wrist_left (47.8, 41.7), placed by hand on the 80 px render (never scaled from 144).
